hero.body: A natural cream for caring for the sensitive area during discomfort caused by haemorrhoids. A plant-based formula designed to soothe, protect and help the inflamed tissue regenerate.

benefits.title: Discomfort shouldn't run your life.
benefits.subtext: PROCTOREX brings discreet, steady relief so you can get back to your routine without worry. A simple, plant-based formula created to soothe and protect inflamed tissue.

cards.title: Quick calming
cards.text: Reduces the feeling of discomfort, itching and burning in the sensitive area.
cards.extra: Extracts of calendula and chamomile are known for their calming effect on irritated skin. Applied locally, PROCTOREX cools the area and reduces the burning and itching sensation from the very first uses.

cards.title: Daily protection
cards.text: Forms a delicate protective layer over the irritated tissue.
cards.extra: Shea butter and witch hazel create an emollient barrier that protects the sensitive area from friction and repeated irritation, especially when walking or sitting for long periods.

cards.title: Regeneration
cards.text: Supports the natural recovery of inflamed tissue.
cards.extra: Aloe vera and lavender deeply hydrate and support the natural healing process of the tissue, contributing to lasting comfort and skin elasticity in the treated area.

cards.title: 100% plants
cards.text: Natural extracts of arnica, celandine, calendula and witch hazel.
cards.extra: The formula contains only plant-based ingredients: arnica, celandine, calendula, lavender, witch hazel and shea butter — with no artificial colourants.

cards.title: Gentle on skin
cards.text: A light formula, fragrance-free, for sensitive skin.
cards.extra: Fragrance-free and alcohol-free, the texture is suitable for sensitive skin, even with repeated use several times a day.

cards.title: Discreet effect
cards.text: A creamy texture that absorbs quickly, with no residue.
cards.extra: It absorbs quickly without leaving marks on clothing. Your order arrives in neutral packaging and the invoice makes no reference to the product.

ingredients.title: The power of plants, in a gentle formula.
ingredients.subtext: Every ingredient was chosen for its natural role: soothing, protection and regeneration. No unnecessary ingredients, no artificial fragrance.
ingredients.ctaText: Any persistent or severe symptom should be evaluated by a doctor. Read the medical note before use.

list.name: Calendula
list.role: Soothing; supports the regeneration of irritated tissue.
list.extra: Calendula (marigold) has been used in skin care for centuries thanks to its soothing effect and properties that support the regeneration of irritated skin.

list.name: Arnica
list.role: Soothes and supports the comfort of sensitive skin.
list.extra: Arnica is traditionally known for its soothing effect on the skin and for supporting local comfort.

list.name: Greater celandine
list.role: Calming, used in traditional skin care.
list.extra: Greater celandine is traditionally used in skin care for its calming properties.

list.name: Lavender
list.role: Calming and relaxing effect on the sensitive area.
list.extra: Lavender oil has calming and relaxing properties, helping to reduce the feeling of tension and discomfort in the applied area.

list.name: Witch hazel
list.role: Tones and reduces the feeling of irritation.
list.extra: Witch hazel extract has a gentle astringent effect: it tones the tissue and reduces the feeling of irritation and itching.

list.name: Shea butter
list.extra: Shea butter is rich in fatty acids and vitamins: it nourishes and protects the skin, maintains elasticity and forms an emollient barrier.

howItWorks.title: How PROCTOREX works
howItWorks.subtext: A formula designed to address the three main needs of the sensitive area: immediate soothing, protection and supporting the regeneration of inflamed tissue.

steps.title: Soothes discomfort
steps.text: Extracts of calendula and arnica calm the feeling of itching, burning and discomfort from the very first applications.

steps.title: Protects the sensitive area
steps.text: Witch hazel and shea butter form a delicate barrier that protects irritated tissue from friction and repeated irritation.

steps.title: Supports regeneration
steps.text: Lavender and shea butter deeply hydrate and support the natural recovery of inflamed tissue, for long-lasting comfort.

usage: Apply a small amount of cream to a clean, dry area.
Use 2–3 times a day or as directed on the label.
For external use only — do not ingest.
howItWorks.note: PROCTOREX is a cosmetic product for external use, designed for the care and comfort of the sensitive area. It does not replace medical advice: if discomfort persists or worsens, consult your doctor.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how PROCTOREX collects, uses and protects your personal data, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR – Regulation (EU) 2016/679).

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
body: The data controller is PROCTOREX, based in Romania. For any question regarding your personal data, contact us at the e-mail address shown on the website.

sections.heading: 2. What data we collect
body: When you place an order, we collect the following data: full name, phone number, country, city, postal code and delivery address.
We do not collect sensitive data or payment data. Card payments are processed exclusively by authorised payment partners, in a secure environment.

sections.heading: 3. Why we use your data
body: We use the collected data exclusively for: processing and delivering orders, contacting you to confirm the order and fulfilling legal obligations (for example, tax obligations).

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
body: Processing is based on the performance of the sales contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and on applicable legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

sections.heading: 5. Third parties
body: We share data only with courier operators (for delivery) and payment processors, strictly to fulfil your order. We never sell or rent your data to third parties.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority. You can exercise your rights with a written request to the contact address.

sections.heading: 7. Retention period
body: We keep order data for as long as required by law (taxation), i.e. 5 years after the order is completed.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
body: For any request regarding your personal data, write to us at the e-mail address shown on the website.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By accessing and using the PROCTOREX website, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before placing an order.

sections.heading: 1. Product description
body: PROCTOREX is a cosmetic cream for external use, plant-based, intended for the care and comfort of the sensitive area.
It is not a medicine and is not intended to diagnose, treat or cure any medical condition.

sections.heading: 2. Informational content
body: The information presented on the website is for informational purposes and does not replace a doctor's consultation or recommendations. For any persistent symptom, consult a specialist.

sections.heading: 3. Orders and prices
body: Displayed prices are in Romanian lei (RON) and include VAT. Your order is confirmed when an operator contacts you by phone.

sections.heading: 4. Payment
body: Payment is made by card or cash on delivery. Card payment data is processed exclusively by authorised payment partners, in a secure environment.

sections.heading: 5. Delivery
body: We deliver across Romania by courier, in neutral and discreet packaging. The estimated delivery time may vary depending on the destination.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of liability
body: PROCTOREX is a natural product and does not guarantee a specific result. Results may vary from person to person.
To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any reactions or consequences resulting from improper use of the product or from use without prior medical advice.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual property
body: The content of the website (texts, images, logo) is the property of PROCTOREX and may not be reproduced without written consent.

sections.heading: 8. Applicable law
body: These terms are governed by Romanian law. Any dispute will be settled by the competent courts of Romania.

disclaimer.title: Medical note
disclaimer.intro: Please read this note carefully before using PROCTOREX.

sections.heading: 1. A cosmetic product, not a medicine
body: PROCTOREX is a cosmetic cream for external use, formulated from plants. It is not a medicine and does not claim to diagnose, treat, relieve or cure haemorrhoids or any other medical condition.

sections.heading: 2. No guarantee of results
body: As a natural product, PROCTOREX does not guarantee a specific outcome. Effectiveness may vary from person to person, and symptoms may persist even after use.

sections.heading: 3. Medical advice is required
body: Before starting any treatment, a medical evaluation is necessary. If you have persistent, severe symptoms or symptoms accompanied by bleeding, intense pain or other warning signs, stop use and consult a doctor immediately.

sections.heading: 4. Correct use
body: Apply only externally, on a clean and dry area, as per the instructions on the label. Do not use on severely damaged skin, do not ingest the product and do not use it if you are hypersensitive to any of the ingredients.

sections.heading: 5. Adverse reactions
body: If irritation, redness or any other reaction occurs, discontinue use and consult a doctor. Do not use the product after its expiry date.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of liability
body: To the extent permitted by law, PROCTOREX accepts no liability for the consequences of using the product without medical advice or for its improper use.
The content of the website and of this note does not constitute medical advice.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how we use cookies on the PROCTOREX website.

sections.heading: 1. What are cookies
body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site work correctly and improve your browsing experience.

sections.heading: 2. What cookies we use
body: We only use essential cookies, required for the website to function (for example, keeping your session and selected language). We do not use advertising or behavioural tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 3. Managing cookies
body: You can delete or block cookies from your browser settings. Please note that blocking essential cookies may affect the correct functioning of the website.

sections.heading: 4. Contact
body: For questions about cookie usage, contact us at the address shown on the website.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.intro: We want you to be satisfied with the product. Here is how returns and refunds work at PROCTOREX.

sections.heading: 1. Right of withdrawal
body: You have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days of receiving the product, in accordance with applicable EU law. In addition, we offer 30 days for returns, free of charge.

sections.heading: 2. Return conditions
body: The product must be returned in its original packaging, unopened and unused, together with proof of purchase. For hygiene reasons, we cannot accept returns of opened products.

sections.heading: 3. How to return
body: To start a return, contact us by phone or e-mail and an operator will give you the steps to follow and the return address.

sections.heading: 4. Refunds
body: The amount paid will be refunded within a maximum of 14 days after receiving the returned product, using the same payment method used for the order.

sections.heading: 5. Exceptions
body: Opened products or products damaged through the customer's fault cannot be returned, unless the product is defective or does not match the order.
